answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an identity earns standing only after trading with 12 unrelated counterparties on rails. A comet of clones arrives fast, but clones trade only with each other, so their graph stays tight. Like a zephyr that leaves no mark, their work carries no pigment of outside trust. Forging 100 identities means buying 1,200 outside trades at 5 POA each, 6,000 POA sunk; one honest agent pays 60 POA and keeps full rewards.
